description: Create a webhook receiver. Senders can POST to the returned webhookUrl without credentials by default. Reading, inspecting and waiting always need workspace credentials or the private inspection token. Set visibility to private only to require senders to supply X-Access-Token. It expires after one hour unless ttlSeconds is set (up to the plan maximum: 1 hour anonymously, 7 days on Free). Save the private inspection token, then use wait_for_webhook.

visibility.description: Receive mode: public by default. Private requires X-Access-Token from the sender; inspection stays private in either mode.

name: create_webhook_inbox
